detailed_description: CSS Animation Generator builds a short snippet for one preset animation. Pick a preset from the built-in list (e.g. bounce), enter duration in seconds, choose a timing function from ease, linear, ease-in, ease-out, or ease-in-out, and pick an iteration count of 1, 2, 3, or infinite. A small preview box plays the animation live, and the output panel shows the corresponding @keyframes block plus an .animated class with the animation shorthand. The Copy button copies the snippet. The tool does not provide a Bezier curve editor, timeline keyframe placement, transform matrix editor, vendor prefixes, animation-fill-mode/direction options, multi-layer composition, or SCSS export.
usage_steps: Click a preset button to pick the animation name (e.g. bounce, fade, slide)
Enter duration in seconds in the number input
Choose a timing function from ease, linear, ease-in, ease-out, or ease-in-out
Pick an iteration count: 1, 2, 3, or infinite
Watch the preview box play the current animation
Click Copy to copy the generated @keyframes block and .animated class snippet
usage_examples: Grab a ready-made bounce animation snippet to attach to a notification icon
Try different timing functions on a fade preset to see how the preview feels
Generate an infinite spinner snippet by picking a rotate preset and infinite iterations
Copy a quick preset and adjust the duration in your own stylesheet later
